title: Seronera Safari Lodge - Overview
body: Nestled in the heart of the Serengeti, Seronera Safari Lodge offers an authentic bush experience with modern comforts. Permanent structures blend seamlessly with the landscape, while the central kopje provides panoramic views across the savanna.
assetAltText: Seronera Safari Lodge exterior at sunset

title: Key Highlights
body: • Central Serengeti location with year-round wildlife|• 75 en-suite rooms with private verandas|• Swimming pool overlooking the plains|• Conference facility for up to 80 delegates|• Bush dinner and sundowner venues

title: SEDMC Safari Fleet
body: Our fleet of Toyota Land Cruiser 200 vehicles is maintained to the highest standards for guest safety and comfort. Each vehicle features pop-up roofs, refrigerated cooler boxes, Wi-Fi hotspot, and charging ports.

title: Day 3 - Balloon Safari Experience
body: Rise before dawn for a magical hot air balloon flight over the Serengeti plains. Watch the sunrise illuminate the savanna as you drift silently above herds of wildebeest and zebra. Celebrate with a champagne breakfast in the bush.
assetAltText: Hot air balloon over Serengeti at sunrise

title: Arusha AV Solutions
body: Full-service audio-visual provider specialising in MICE events across East Africa. From intimate boardroom setups to gala dinners for 500 guests, our technical team delivers flawless execution.
